ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white/grey) pixels are localized to the distal tips and lower trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-mass (low intensity) centrally; high-contrast mottled grey-to-white regions at coordinates roughly corresponding to the outer 15% of both lobe tips and along segments of the inferior margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 145 degrees and a shallow depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-4 pixel height) consistently distributed along the superior trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward convexity on the superior boundary of both lobes, tapering to pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly concentrated high-intensity circular pixel clusters located at the extreme terminal ends of both fluke lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization zones.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, thickened texture and heavy colonization at the distal tips of both lobes, indicative of extensive parasitic load or associated scarring.
